description: Overview Code Clash 2026 (2.0) is the annual inter-departmental and inter-college flagship competitive programming festival organized by the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Deen Bandhu Chhotu Ram University of Science and Technology (DCRUST), Murthal. Designed to test your algorithmic proficiency, mental agility, and core coding skills, this high-pressure competitive environment will push your problem-solving limits. Important Dates Event Window: October 12 – 15, 2026 (Final exact dates will be announced soon!) Event Formats Blind Coding: A unique, high-intensity challenge where you code without viewing your monitor. Test your syntax retention, mental compilation, and coding accuracy in the dark. DSA Battle: An advanced competitive programming showdown featuring complex problems based on Data Structures, Algorithms, Dynamic Programming, and optimization. Innovation Competition: Build future solutions and pitch your ideas to prove your technical creativity. Who Can Participate? Open to all tech enthusiasts, from first-year undergraduate students to advanced senior competitive programmers across different departments and colleges. Prizes & Rewards Compete to claim exciting prizes and exciting swags!
organiser: Deenbandhu Chhotu Ram University Of Science And Technology (DCRUST), Murthal, Haryana

Overview

Code Clash 2026 (2.0) is the annual inter-departmental and inter-college flagship competitive programming festival organized by the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Deen Bandhu Chhotu Ram University of Science and Technology (DCRUST), Murthal. Designed to test your algorithmic proficiency, mental agility, and core coding skills, this high-pressure competitive environment will push your problem-solving limits.

Important Dates

Event Window: October 12 – 15, 2026 (Final exact dates will be announced soon!)

Event Formats

  • Blind Coding: A unique, high-intensity challenge where you code without viewing your monitor. Test your syntax retention, mental compilation, and coding accuracy in the dark.
  • DSA Battle: An advanced competitive programming showdown featuring complex problems based on Data Structures, Algorithms, Dynamic Programming, and optimization.
  • Innovation Competition: Build future solutions and pitch your ideas to prove your technical creativity.

Who Can Participate?

  • Open to all tech enthusiasts, from first-year undergraduate students to advanced senior competitive programmers across different departments and colleges.

Prizes & Rewards

  • Compete to claim exciting prizes and exciting swags!
